_provenance: Every request/expectation pair here drives a real entry in fixtures/api-conformance-registry.json, transcribed from Camelid's own src/api/contract.rs and src/api/mod.rs. Each case now carries an explicit `evidence` block per BASELINE_EVAL_PLAN.md's behavioral-oracle-vs-evidence-reference split: registryId names the contract.rs entry (which may be a HEAD-only addition), while evidence.evidenceReference cites where the underlying BEHAVIOR was independently confirmed present at v0.6.1 — the two are allowed to diverge, and SC-1..5 here are exactly the case where they do.

cases.description: temperature < 0 is a typed 400. The named contract.rs entry 'sampling_temperature' is a HEAD-only addition (not present at v0.6.1 — confirmed 20 vs 28 total contract.rs cases), but the runtime validation and 'invalid_sampling_parameter' error code were already present at v0.6.1.

evidence.evidenceReference: src/api/mod.rs typed-error dispatch (invalid_sampling_parameter hits at ~10266/15656) + tests/api_vertical_slice.rs:2021, confirmed present at the v0.6.1 tag
same validation path as case 1; temperature=0 is the documented greedy baseline throughout qa/evidence-bundles/

cases.description: top_k of exactly 0 is a typed 400 invalid_sampling_parameter.

cases.description: REAL, DOCUMENTED QUIRK: a negative top_k cannot deserialize into the unsigned wire field, so it fails at the JSON layer with a DIFFERENT, untyped 400 — not the ErrorEnvelope shape. This is a serde/Rust type-system fact (top_k was already u32 at v0.6.1), not app-logic that could have changed across versions.

evidence.evidenceReference: top_k: Option<u32> field type confirmed present verbatim in src/api/mod.rs at the v0.6.1 tag; negative-number-into-u32 deserialization failure follows from serde/Rust, independent of app version

cases.description: NARROWER THAN THE FULL CONTRACT: this case only confirms stream_options.include_usage does not cause an error on the non-streaming path (gradeSelfConformanceCase always sends stream:false). The real contract's terminal-usage-chunk behavior only applies when streaming, and isn't covered by this grader — that needs the streaming-aware path regression-museum already has. Left as a smaller, honest case rather than an overclaimed one.
